subject.scope: Universal: for every typed input in the Dafny model that satisfies the precondition of the specified method (unbounded integers, finite maps, sequences and strings), each refinement of the specification allows at most one result, and the specification leaves no compiled function, predicate or method without a body except the specified method. Source level. No bounded search. Not checked: ghost definitions without a body, constants without a value, opaque types.

assumptions: Dafny mathematical integers and finite sequences and strings; sequential pure calls; all typed inputs.

The claim text is certificate/BookingCertificateSpec.dfy with BookingDualCert.dfy. It is a CANDIDATE specification, NOT approved intent. The batch problem (maximise the value under slot capacities) is not the approved booking specification, which has no batch, no value and no optimum.
The two hash texts are inputs. No claim that they are hashes of the board or of the batch.
The bridge (Q6) covers one predicate (NoDoubleBooking) and one batch shape. It does not link the batch model to the approved method Apply.
Source proof does not cover compilation to JavaScript, the issuer process, encoding, hashing, signing, the sink, storage, the optimizers or deployment.
The hand-written claim lemmas and the subject list must be read by a person (Slice 2 limit).
evidence.statement_plain_english: A token is only for an allocation that is 0/1 and uses no slot above its capacity. The token holds exactly the capacities that remain, and none of them is negative.

core.note: Dafny makes no new proof task for the inherited members of the instance. The instance makes Dafny report a member without a body and a print effect of the bound core. The proofs are those of the abstract claim module; they hold for every refinement of the specification. The core itself is a non-abstract refinement: Decide (correctness) is its proof against the specified contract.

source_proof.print_effects: Every verify command has the gate option --track-print-effects. Decide of the specification and the callers in the claim file have no {:print} attribute.

NOT trusted for what they SEND: the optimizers (guests/booking/*), rustc, the runner (guest.ts). A wrong optimizer or a wrong rustc can lose a booking. Through the line that it sends, an optimizer cannot make the sink take an allocation without a token. That it cannot act in another way rests on the sandbox above.
